sample: Every prepared stock and SPY in both original pilot origins; retain unavailable outcomes without replacing stocks or dates. Report SPY separately from stocks.
origin: Original archived close, no lead; common SPY calendar, maturity exactly h sessions later; never shift endpoints per instrument.
forecast: Model-implied distributions reconstructed now from the original archived pilot inputs and unchanged production modules. Not distributions sealed in 2024/2025, and not the original weekly portfolio-selection draws. Horizon remains one year; daily prefixes define 21/63/252-session distributions.
target: Underlying gross total-return kernel before cash-dividend accounting. Compare to adjusted-close ratio minus one, a gross reinvested total-return proxy. Does not validate cash-dividend terminal wealth, payment timing, withholding, execution or account decisions.
baseline: Same origin and prepared EWMA covariance; zero arithmetic drift, flat variance, Gaussian GBM, no regime mixture or anchor uncertainty. This comparison changes several components jointly and cannot attribute performance to one component.
exclusions: Require exact positive adjusted endpoints; exclude documented later non-split adjustments through frozen market cut. Preserve immature and missing rows; score models on identical rows.
inference: Two origins, correlated stocks and overlapping annual windows: descriptive per origin/horizon only. No pooled inference, confidence intervals, calibration certification or evidence of economic advantage.
freezing: Archive distributions and protocol before running the outcome scorer. Period and prices were previously inspected, so this is not an independent holdout or prospective preregistration. No changes to seed, model, universe, weights, limits or kernel after scoring.
